status_definitions.completed: Implemented in development; not necessarily available in a public App Store release.
status_definitions.planned: Planned or under consideration; timing may change.

title.zh-CN: 视频收藏库与视频内笔记

description.en: Organize saved videos and links in collections, and add notes at specific moments while watching.
description.zh-CN: 将保存的视频和链接整理到收藏夹，并在观看时为指定时间点添加笔记。

title.en: Picture in Picture and background audio

description.en: Implemented for local videos and supported direct video URLs. These capabilities are not promised for embedded YouTube playback.
description.zh-CN: 已针对本地视频和受支持的视频直链实现。YouTube 内嵌播放不承诺支持这些功能。

title.en: YouTube link previews and embedded playback
title.zh-CN: YouTube 链接预览与内嵌播放

description.en: Save YouTube links with available metadata and watch using embedded playback. YouTube video downloading is not supported.
description.zh-CN: 保存 YouTube 链接及可获取的元数据，并通过内嵌播放器观看；不支持下载 YouTube 视频。

description.en: Preparing subscription access and purchase restoration for premium playback and timeline-note features.
description.zh-CN: 正在完善高级播放与时间轴笔记等 Pro 功能的订阅解锁和恢复购买体验。

description.en: Traditional Chinese is planned in response to user requests. Availability will be confirmed in a future update.
description.zh-CN: 已收到用户对繁体中文的需求，计划在后续版本支持，具体上线时间以更新公告为准。

title.zh-CN: 用户建议：支持繁体中文

response.en: Thanks for the suggestion. Traditional Chinese is on our near-term localization plan. Other ideas are welcome.
response.zh-CN: 感谢建议。繁体中文已列入近期本地化计划，也欢迎继续提出其他功能建议。
